description: Automatically load AGENTS.md with CLAUDE.md fallback in coax/lib/microcoder/instructions.coax and wire into loop.coax/run.coax.

steps.send: Add automatic workspace instruction loading to Microcoder: create `coax/lib/microcoder/instructions.coax` (and `coax/lib/microcoder/instructions-selftest.coax`) that discovers and loads `AGENTS.md` (with `CLAUDE.md` fallback) from the workspace root, wire it into `coax/lib/microcoder/loop.coax`, `coax/lib/microcoder/run.coax`, `coax/lib/agent/engine/microcoder.coax`, and `coder/tui/mcworker.coax`. Verify with `coax/bin/coax test coax/lib/microcoder/instructions-selftest.coax`.
